name: M3_MMS100MI_AddDOLine
description: Create a new line on an existing distribution order by providing the order number, item number, and quantity in the item’s basic unit of measure. The line can include optional warehouse, location, lot, container, catch weight, reason code, remark, and project information so that stock and planning are correctly identified. After a successful call, M3 returns the order number together with the created line number and line suffix, which can be used to retrieve or update the line in later operations.

inputParameters.name: TRNR
inputParameters.description: Distribution order number to which the new line will be added.

inputParameters.name: ITNO
inputParameters.description: Item number for the product on the new distribution order line.

inputParameters.name: TRQT
inputParameters.description: Ordered quantity in basic unit of measure for the new distribution order line.

inputParameters.name: WHLO
inputParameters.description: Warehouse for this distribution order line.

inputParameters.name: ALUN
inputParameters.description: Alternate unit of measure in which the transaction quantity is expressed on this line.

inputParameters.name: TRDT
inputParameters.description: Planned issue date for this distribution order line.

inputParameters.name: TIHM
inputParameters.description: Planned issue time for this distribution order line.

inputParameters.name: WHSL
inputParameters.description: Stock location in the warehouse from which the goods will be issued.

inputParameters.name: TWSL
inputParameters.description: Destination location in the receiving warehouse for this line.

inputParameters.name: RSCD
inputParameters.description: Reason code explaining why this distribution order line is created or changed.

inputParameters.name: BANO
inputParameters.description: Lot number identifying the specific batch for this line.

inputParameters.name: CAMU
inputParameters.description: Container identifier on which the goods for this line are handled.

inputParameters.name: CAWE
inputParameters.description: Catch weight associated with the lot or container for this line.

inputParameters.name: BREM
inputParameters.description: Free-text remark for this distribution order line or its balance identity.

inputParameters.name: REFE
inputParameters.description: User-defined reference linked to this distribution order line.

inputParameters.name: BREF
inputParameters.description: First additional lot reference associated with the lot on this line.

inputParameters.name: BRE2
inputParameters.description: Second additional lot reference associated with the lot on this line.

inputParameters.name: PROJ
inputParameters.description: Project number to which this distribution order line is linked.

inputParameters.name: ELNO
inputParameters.description: Project element within the project that this distribution order line relates to.

outputParameters.name: TRNR
outputParameters.description: Distribution order number for which the line was created.

outputParameters.name: PONR
outputParameters.description: Line number assigned to the new distribution order line.

outputParameters.name: POSX
outputParameters.description: Line suffix identifying any sub-line created under the main line number.
